preview: Started the sumatriptan, took two pills today, headache went down…
body: Hi Dr. Chen — quick update. Started the sumatriptan and took two pills today (one at 8am for a moderate migraine, then another around noon when it came back). Headache pain dropped from 7/10 to 3/10 within 30 mins both times. No side effects — no chest tightness, no jaw discomfort. Should I keep the same plan or adjust?

preview: Pre-screening for Tessa Bright complete. BP 122/78, all vitals normal. Ready to see her at 11:30.
body: Hi Dr. Chen — pre-screening for Tessa Bright is complete. Vitals: BP 122/78, HR 72, T 98.4F, RR 14, SpO2 99%. Med list verified — no changes since last visit. She's ready to see you at 11:30. Notes from intake attached.

preview: Concerns about the new metformin — getting some GI upset
body: Hi Dr. Chen, I started the metformin yesterday at 500mg twice daily. I'm getting some pretty significant GI upset — nausea after taking it, and some loose stools. I read that this can happen at the start. Should I stick with it for a week to see if it settles, or call back sooner?

preview: Knee swelling came back today after PT — should I stop?
body: Dr. Chen, my knee was looking great until today. After PT this morning, the swelling came back, almost like it was 2 weeks ago. Pain is moderate (4-5/10). I iced it and elevated. Should I skip the next PT session, or push through?

preview: Reminder: state license renewal for NJ due May 18 (pending CME)
body: Quick reminder: your NJ medical license is up for renewal on May 18. The CME requirement is 25 hours over the past 2 years; you're currently at 18. There's a webinar series for opioid prescribing CME (4 credits) running this Saturday — link attached. Want me to register you?

preview: Sleep is much better this week. Wanted to say thanks.
body: Hi Dr. Chen — short note, but the past week's been the best sleep I've had in months. Falling asleep around 11, waking up at 6:45 without the alarm. The therapy combined with the SSRI seems to be working. See you next week.
